summary: Focus Universal Inc., through wholly owned subsidiary Lusher Holding LLC, filed an 8-K to report the acquisition of a Class A office and commercial building with a four-level parking structure at 901 Corporate Center Drive, Monterey Park, CA. The aggregate purchase price was $17.7 million, exclusive of closing costs, funded by an $11.05 million term loan from East West Bank and $5.8 million cash. The seller was 901 Corporate Center, LP, an unrelated party. The property is 99.2% occupied with 16 tenants, and the company plans to occupy only ~2,000 sq ft. Lee Associates was retained to manage the property. Watch for integration of the property and lease management; no risk-arb spread as this is a real estate acquisition.
